summary: This tutorial explains how to customize slide backgrounds and designs in LibreOffice Impress, using version 3.3.4 on a GNU/Linux operating system. It covers selecting and applying custom backgrounds, modifying master slides, and adding design elements like shapes and logos. To change the background, open a sample presentation, then use the Slide Master option to apply changes to all slides. For a solid background, select the slide, go to Format > Page, choose Bitmap from the Fill dropdown, and select Blank. Adjust text color to ensure it contrasts with the background for readability. To add a shape, use the Basic Shapes toolbar to draw rectangles or other shapes on the slide. Dragging from the top-left corner creates a new shape. Control points allow resizing and repositioning the shape. This tutorial provides step-by-step guidance on enhancing presentations through background customization and design elements.
